title: Groovy compiler-referenced ABI surface registry
description: Authoritative registry of the elements marked with @org.apache.groovy.lang.annotation.GroovyABI across the modules that make up the hidden compiler-to-runtime binary ABI contract. See COMPATIBILITY.md for the governing policy.

version.description: The Groovy version this registry snapshot belongs to (or "SNAPSHOT").

module.description: One Gradle module (project) whose compiled classes carry @GroovyABI. The module owns its elements by nesting.

name.description: Member name; for constructors the simple class name.

descriptor.description: JVM descriptor of the member, the exact signature emitted bytecode binds to.

deprecated-since.description: The previous-major-line release in which the element was marked @Deprecated, authorizing a later intentional break. Null when not deprecated.

tombstone.description: Non-null when this element is a recorded intentional break: the entry stays in the registry after the live ABI entry is gone, marking where it used to be.

type.description: Optional fully-qualified type name, used as documentation and for human review. The authoritative owner is the enclosing module.

version.description: The release in which the intentional break lands.

previous-since.description: Required for version-changed: the since value before the change.

note.description: Human-readable reason for the intentional break.
